entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse HR monitor. I'd like to see about returning it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh no, it works perfectly fine. To be honest, I've just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and I've realized I just don't use it enough to justify keeping it.
I see. So it's not a defect, you're just not finding it as useful as you'd hoped. I understand completely.
Exactly. So, what are my options? I know it's been a couple of weeks. Can I get a partial credit, or maybe a discount code for a future purchase if a full return isn't possible?
Let me check the return eligibility for your order right now. Just one moment while I pull up the details.
Okay, thanks for holding. I've reviewed the policy, and it looks like your VeloBand Pulse is well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, 90 days? That's fantastic! I was worried I might have missed the cutoff. I was already starting to look into the options for resale if it came to that.

No need for that. I'm happy we can take care of it for you. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's all. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks again for calling VeloFit.
